description: Return the federal Sonnendach solar-energy suitability of the roof surface(s) within 5 m of the given WGS84 coordinates, nearest first: suitability class, mean irradiation per m² (kWh/m²/yr), total roof-surface irradiation (kWh/yr), roof area, orientation and slope. Orientation follows the Sonnendach convention: 0° = south, −90° = east, +90° = west, ±180° = north.
name: get_solar_potential
title: Get roof solar potential (Sonnendach)
